_comment: Fixture for the mocked lookup_media tool. Shape matches the real Publer GET /api/v1/media response (see https://publer.com/docs/api-reference/media). Permanent paths use cdn.publer.com/uploads/...; temporary ones use /uploads/tmp/ and must NEVER appear here. The Fixer queries this by a hint (filename/hash) and either gets a real permanent URL back or None (→ escalate to human).
